name: PostgreSQL
description: The default relational database. It is never published to the network: other containers reach it over the Docker network, and the dashboard's Databases page connects to it directly.

access.note: Nothing signs in through a browser: port 5432 is internal-only and never proxied, so this deployment has no address to open. Other containers reach it over the Docker network as the user you named here, with the generated password revealed from the Variables tab, and the dashboard's Databases page picks up the same pair on its own. Note that POSTGRES_USER is the cluster superuser, not an account scoped to one database.

secrets.name: password
secrets.label: Database password
secrets.description: Generated on this host. Reveal it from the Variables tab when an application needs it.

ports.name: postgres
ports.purpose: SQL connections from other containers on this host

automation.name: Nightly backup
automation.description: Dumps the database every night before most people are awake.

update.notes: PostgreSQL major versions need an explicit dump and restore; the minor tag policy keeps this blueprint inside one major.
